Bakery favourites

The bakes Bay Bakery is known for — made fresh and ready for takeaway or delivery. Visit or call for today's availability.

Cakes

Celebration and everyday cakes for birthdays, family gatherings and sweet cravings.

Cookies

A wide assortment of cookies — perfect with chai or as a gift box for loved ones.

Pizzas

Fresh-baked pizzas, hot from the oven — a savoury favourite alongside the sweets.

Cream Rolls

Flaky, golden rolls filled with smooth cream — a classic Bay Bakery treat.

Mini Cream Puffs

Bite-sized puffs filled with cream — light, sweet and hard to stop at just one.

Chocolate Croissants

Buttery, flaky croissants with rich chocolate — best enjoyed fresh.

Three-Milk Cake

Soft sponge soaked in three milks, topped with whipped cream — moist and indulgent.

Red Velvet Pastries

Velvety red layers with smooth cream frosting — a customer favourite.

Biscuits

Everyday biscuits in many varieties — the perfect tea-time companion.
